claims: The 2026 Masters Tournament is scheduled for April 6–12.
The 2026 Masters Tournament is televised on ESPN Thursday-Friday.
The 2026 Masters Tournament is televised on CBS Saturday-Sunday.
Extensive streaming of the 2026 Masters Tournament is available on Masters.com.
Extensive streaming of the 2026 Masters Tournament is available on the Masters App.
Extensive streaming of the 2026 Masters Tournament is available on Paramount+.
Extensive streaming of the 2026 Masters Tournament is available on Prime Video.

Key coverage of the 2026 Masters Tournament includes "Amen Corner".
Key coverage of the 2026 Masters Tournament includes holes 4, 5, 6, 15, and 16.

Round 1 coverage of the 2026 Masters Tournament is 1–3 p.m. ET on Prime Video.
